title: Ekwupụta Okwu n'ime Ọdịdị
intro: Otu onye pụtara site n'akụkọ ihe mere eme dị nsọ, na-ebu ọrụ ebube ndị megidere usoro okike. Mkpụrụ obi a rutere site n'otu iwu Chineke, chebere nne ma ọ bụ nna pụọ ​​​​n'ebubo dị njọ, wee pụọ n'ụwa a tupu agbụ ụwa ekechie ha. Akụkọ ahụ sitere na nwa dị ala ruo n'eluigwe dị n'elu. Ònye ka nke a ga-abụ?
clues: E zigara m dịka ihe ịrịba ama na ebere sitere n'aka Allah nye ụmụ Izrel.
Ọbịbịa m dị iche na nke mbụ — m malitere ịdị ndụ site n'okwu Chineke bụ́ 'Bụrụnụ!' na-enweghị nna nke ụwa.
Nne na nna m chere okwu mkparị obi ọjọọ ihu, mana mkpughe dị nsọ bịara iji kwupụta na aka ha dị ọcha ma bulie ọnọdụ ha elu.
Dịka nwa ọhụrụ, m tụrụ ndị gbara m gburugburu n'anya site n'ikwu okwu doro anya site n'oge m nọ n'afọ iji kpochapụ aha nne na nna m.
Site n'ikike Chineke, ejiri m ụrọ na-enweghị ndụ kpụọ ndụ, mee ka ndị ìsì hụ ụzọ, ma jiri aka m gwọọ onye ekpenta ahụ.
E buliri m elu n'eluigwe tupu ihe ọjọọ emee m, m ga-alọghachikwa n'ụwa a tupu Awa ikpeazụ abịa.

arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱبْنَ مَرْيَمَ وَأُمَّهُۥٓ ءَايَةًۭ وَءَاوَيْنَـٰهُمَآ إِلَىٰ رَبْوَةٍۢ ذَاتِ قَرَارٍۢ وَمَعِينٍۢ
verse: And We made the son of Mary and his mother a sign and sheltered them within a high ground having level [areas] and flowing water. (23:50)
